import * as stylex from "@stylexjs/stylex";

export const raster = stylex.defineVars({
  paper: "var(--bg)",
  ink: "var(--text)",
  gray: "var(--text-secondary)",
  divider: "var(--divider)",
  dividerSubtle: "var(--divider-subtle)",
  gridLine: "var(--grid-line)",
  radiusSm: "var(--radius-sm)",
  radiusChrome: "var(--radius-chrome)",
  pad: "var(--pad)",
  gutter: "var(--gutter)",
  module: "var(--grid-size)",
  hit: "var(--hit)",
  controlH: "var(--control-h)",
  controlFs: "var(--control-fs)",
  durationSnap: "var(--duration-snap)",
  ease: "var(--ease)",
  hairline: "1px",
});

raster.snippet: Fixed fee. The number on the cover is the number on the invoice.
